title: Skin Care for Kolkata Weather: A Light Routine for Humidity, Monsoon and a Short Winter
ex: Hot, humid months, a long monsoon, Durga Puja nights and a short, hazy winter: how to keep a simple skin care routine for Kolkata weather.
rt: Skin Care for Kolkata Weather: Season-by-Season | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Kolkata weather: light moisturiser, daily sunscreen, the long monsoon, Durga Puja nights, hazy winters and AC offices, made simple.
quick: Kolkata is hot and humid from about March to October with a long monsoon, so skin does best with a light moisturiser, a broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning and a proper night cleanse. Add a little more cream only in the short, drier winter from about December to February.
facts: Kolkata is humid for most of the year
The monsoon runs roughly June to September
Winter is short, cooler and drier, with hazy evenings
Sunscreen is needed on cloudy days too
